ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Contagious Interview' — node.exe spawning curl/python loader for BeaverTail/InvisibleFerret
ucs.description: Hunts the DPRK Contagious Interview (a.k.a. DEV#POPPER / Famous Chollima) chain where a victim runs a malicious npm package shipped as a 'coding test', causing node.exe (executed from a user-writable path) to spawn curl/PowerShell/Python that fetches the second-stage InvisibleFerret payload and harvests browser+wallet data. Tied to Lazarus (Labyrinth Chollima / Diamond Sleet) by the npm-loader job-lure pivot, the .n2/.npl drop directories, and the BeaverTail atom set.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as command_lines values(Processes.process_path) as process_paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="node.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("curl.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_path Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(command_lines,"(?i)(npmaudit|npmlogin|invisibleferret|beavertail|Invoke-WebRequest|DownloadString|urlretrieve|requests\.get|\.n2|\.npl|wallet|MetaMask|Coinbase|Phantom)") | where match(parent_process_path,"(?i)\\\\(Downloads|Desktop|AppData|Temp|tmp|Repo)\\\\") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let SuspiciousAtoms = dynamic(["npmaudit","npmlogin","beavertail","invisibleferret",".n2/",".npl/","MetaMask","Coinbase","Phantom","wallet"]);
let ScriptAtoms = dynamic(["Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","urlretrieve","requests.get","curl -s","-OutFile"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("curl.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (SuspiciousAtoms) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (ScriptAtoms)
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath matches regex @"(?i)\\(Downloads|Desktop|AppData|Temp|tmp|Repo|Projects|source)\\"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildFile  = FileName,
          ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\node.exe"
| where NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(curl|powershell|pwsh|python3?|wscript|cscript|cmd)\.exe$"
| where CommandLine has_any ("npmaudit","npmlogin","beavertail","invisibleferret",".n2",".npl","wallet","MetaMask","Coinbase","Phantom")
   or CommandLine has_any ("Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","urlretrieve","requests.get","-OutFile")
| where ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(Downloads|Desktop|AppData|Temp|tmp|Repo|Projects|source)\\"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus Contagious Interview - node.exe Spawning Loader Scripts
id: 9a1d2c30-7e44-4a4d-8c6d-1f4e6e9b2c11
status: experimental
description: Detects node.exe (run from a user-writable / project path) spawning curl/PowerShell/Python with atoms tied to Lazarus BeaverTail/InvisibleFerret npm-package loaders delivered through fake coding-interview lures.
references:
  - https://www.securonix.com/blog/analysis-of-dev-popper-new-attack-campaign-targeting-software-developers
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/03
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_node:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\node.exe'
  parent_path:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\Desktop\'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\tmp\'
      - '\Repo\'
      - '\Projects\'
      - '\source\'
  child_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  atoms_loader:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'npmaudit'
      - 'npmlogin'
      - 'beavertail'
      - 'invisibleferret'
      - '.n2'
      - '.npl'
      - 'wallet'
      - 'MetaMask'
      - 'Coinbase'
      - 'Phantom'
  atoms_script:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'urlretrieve'
      - 'requests.get'
      - '-OutFile'
  condition: parent_node and parent_path and child_proc and (atoms_loader or atoms_script)
falsepositives:
  - Genuine developer fetching a package via a custom postinstall script (rare combination of all four predicates)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.g0032
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@ParentImage:*\\node.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\NODE.EXE) (@Image:*\\curl.exe OR @Image:*\\CURL.EXE OR @Image:*\\powershell.exe OR @Image:*\\PowerShell.exe OR @Image:*\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR @Image:*\\pwsh.exe OR @Image:*\\python.exe OR @Image:*\\PYTHON.EXE OR @Image:*\\python3.exe OR @Image:*\\wscript.exe OR @Image:*\\cscript.exe OR @Image:*\\cmd.exe) (@CommandLine:*npmaudit* OR @CommandLine:*npmlogin* OR @CommandLine:*beavertail* OR @CommandLine:*invisibleferret* OR @CommandLine:*.n2* OR @CommandLine:*.npl* OR @CommandLine:*MetaMask* OR @CommandLine:*Phantom* OR @CommandLine:*Invoke-WebRequest* OR @CommandLine:*DownloadString* OR @CommandLine:*urlretrieve* OR @CommandLine:*requests.get*) (@ParentImage:*\\Downloads\\* OR @ParentImage:*\\Desktop\\* OR @ParentImage:*\\AppData\\* OR @ParentImage:*\\Temp\\* OR @ParentImage:*\\tmp\\* OR @ParentImage:*\\Repo\\* OR @ParentImage:*\\Projects\\* OR @ParentImage:*\\source\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^node\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(curl|powershell|pwsh|python3?|wscript|cscript|cmd)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(npmaudit|npmlogin|beavertail|invisibleferret|\\.n2|\\.npl|MetaMask|Coinbase|Phantom|wallet|Invoke-WebRequest|DownloadString|urlretrieve|requests\\.get|-OutFile)", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)\\\\(Downloads|Desktop|AppData|Temp|tmp|Repo|Projects|source)\\\\", field=ParentImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentImageFileName], function={ count() | min(@timestamp) })
ucs.rationale: node.exe as a parent process is uncommon on most managed endpoints; chaining it with a non-JS child (curl/python/powershell) AND a Lazarus-specific second-stage atom (npmaudit/npmlogin/beavertail/invisibleferret/.n2/.npl) AND a user-writable parent path is a near-unique fingerprint of the DPRK Contagious Interview / DEV#POPPER tradecraft documented across Securonix, Unit 42, and Palo Alto reports

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus Operation Dream Job — DLL side-loaded by legitimate signed host executed from user-writable path
ucs.description: Hunts the Operation Dream Job / Operation In(ter)ception delivery pattern (LinkedIn job-lure ISO/IMG) where Lazarus drops a legitimate Microsoft/3rd-party signed EXE alongside a malicious DLL with the matching import name, then relies on Windows DLL search order to side-load the implant (BLINDINGCAN, MIRRORSTEALER, FUDMODULE, COPPERHEDGE). Tied to Lazarus (ZINC / Diamond Sleet / Labyrinth Chollima) by the recurring host-binary set (DTHelper, ColorCpl, OptionalFeatures, IEC, wsmprovhost, msedgewebview2, credwiz, CameraSettingsUIHost) executed out of an ISO mount or extracted archive from explor
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as command_lines values(Processes.process_path) as process_paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("wsmprovhost.exe","DTHelper.exe","ColorCpl.exe","OptionalFeatures.exe","IEC.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","cookie_exporter.exe","credwiz.exe","wmiapsrv.exe","CameraSettingsUIHost.exe","msdtc.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","isoburn.exe","winrar.exe","7zG.exe","7zFM.exe","wmplayer.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process_paths,"(?i)\\\\(Users|Downloads|Desktop|Temp|AppData|ProgramData)\\\\") | where NOT match(process_paths,"(?i)^C:\\\\Program Files") | where NOT match(process_paths,"(?i)^C:\\\\Windows") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let UserPaths = dynamic([@"\Users\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Desktop\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\"]);
let SignedHosts = dynamic(["wsmprovhost.exe","DTHelper.exe","ColorCpl.exe","OptionalFeatures.exe","IEC.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","cookie_exporter.exe","credwiz.exe","wmiapsrv.exe","CameraSettingsUIHost.exe","msdtc.exe"]);
let ArchiveParents = dynamic(["explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","isoburn.exe","winrar.exe","7zG.exe","7zFM.exe","wmplayer.exe"]);
let HostExecs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ (SignedHosts)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ArchiveParents)
    | where FolderPath has_any (UserPaths)
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project HostTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              HostBin=FileName, HostFolder=FolderPath, HostPid=ProcessId,
              HostCmd=ProcessCommandLine, HostSha=SHA256,
              ParentBin=InitiatingProcessFileName;
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SignedHosts)
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
| where FolderPath =~ InitiatingProcessFolderPath           // co-located DLL — textbook side-load
| join kind=inner HostExecs on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.HostPid
| project DllLoadTime=Timestamp, HostTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentBin, HostBin, HostFolder, HostCmd,
          LoadedDll=FileName, DllSha256=SHA256
| order by DllLoadTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let SignedHosts = dynamic(["wsmprovhost.exe","DTHelper.exe","ColorCpl.exe","OptionalFeatures.exe","IEC.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","cookie_exporter.exe","credwiz.exe","wmiapsrv.exe","CameraSettingsUIHost.exe","msdtc.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend BinName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where BinName in~ (SignedHosts)
| where NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(Users|Downloads|Desktop|Temp|AppData|ProgramData)\\"
| where NewProcessName !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
| where NewProcessName !startswith @"C:\Windows"
| where ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(explorer|msiexec|isoburn|winrar|7zG|7zFM|wmplayer)\.exe$"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus Operation Dream Job - Signed Side-Load Host Run From User-Writable Path
id: 1f7c9a45-3b21-4ee6-9d4c-c6e2d5e6a710
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of a signed Windows / Microsoft binary historically abused by Lazarus (Operation Dream Job, Operation In(ter)ception) for DLL side-loading, launched from a user-writable path (ISO mount or extracted archive) with an explorer/winrar/isoburn parent.
references:
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/lazarus-operation-dream-job
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/09/29/zinc-weaponizing-open-source-software/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/03
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_bin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wsmprovhost.exe'
      - '\DTHelper.exe'
      - '\ColorCpl.exe'
      - '\OptionalFeatures.exe'
      - '\IEC.exe'
      - '\msedgewebview2.exe'
      - '\cookie_exporter.exe'
      - '\credwiz.exe'
      - '\wmiapsrv.exe'
      - '\CameraSettingsUIHost.exe'
      - '\msdtc.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\Desktop\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\isoburn.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7zG.exe'
      - '\7zFM.exe'
      - '\wmplayer.exe'
  filter_legit_paths:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
      - 'C:\Windows\'
  condition: all of selection_* and not filter_legit_paths
falsepositives:
  - User running a portable copy of one of these tools out of Downloads (uncommon)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0032
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:*\\wsmprovhost.exe OR @Image:*\\WsmProvHost.exe OR @Image:*\\DTHelper.exe OR @Image:*\\dthelper.exe OR @Image:*\\ColorCpl.exe OR @Image:*\\colorcpl.exe OR @Image:*\\OptionalFeatures.exe OR @Image:*\\optionalfeatures.exe OR @Image:*\\IEC.exe OR @Image:*\\iec.exe OR @Image:*\\msedgewebview2.exe OR @Image:*\\MsEdgeWebView2.exe OR @Image:*\\cookie_exporter.exe OR @Image:*\\credwiz.exe OR @Image:*\\CredWiz.exe OR @Image:*\\wmiapsrv.exe OR @Image:*\\WmiApSrv.exe OR @Image:*\\CameraSettingsUIHost.exe OR @Image:*\\msdtc.exe OR @Image:*\\MSDTC.EXE) (@Image:*\\Users\\* OR @Image:*\\Downloads\\* OR @Image:*\\Desktop\\* OR @Image:*\\Temp\\* OR @Image:*\\AppData\\* OR @Image:*\\ProgramData\\*) (@ParentImage:*\\explorer.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\Explorer.EXE OR @ParentImage:*\\EXPLORER.EXE OR @ParentImage:*\\msiexec.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\MsiExec.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\isoburn.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\winrar.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\WinRAR.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\7zG.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\7zFM.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\wmplayer.exe) -@Image:C:\\Program* -@Image:C:\\Windows\\*
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(wsmprovhost|DTHelper|ColorCpl|OptionalFeatures|IEC|msedgewebview2|cookie_exporter|credwiz|wmiapsrv|CameraSettingsUIHost|msdtc)\.exe$/i
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(explorer|msiexec|isoburn|winrar|7zG|7zFM|wmplayer)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\\\\(Users|Downloads|Desktop|Temp|AppData|ProgramData)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT regex("(?i)^C:\\\\Program Files", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT regex("(?i)^C:\\\\Windows\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, SHA256HashData], function={ count() | min(@timestamp) })
ucs.rationale: Legitimate copies of `DTHelper.exe`, `ColorCpl.exe`, `OptionalFeatures.exe`, `IEC.exe`, `wsmprovhost.exe`, `CameraSettingsUIHost.exe`, etc. only ever execute from `C:\Windows\System32` or `C:\Program Files`. Lazarus has repeatedly bundled these exact signed hosts into ISO/IMG payloads delivered through LinkedIn recruiter lures so they side-load a co-located malicious DLL (BLINDINGCAN, MIRRORSTEALE
